CIK ME MUCORO IKOM RWOM MA KIMEDO IKOM GIN ACATA – VAT
Tye pi anga
Kit yub ne
Tye pi kare ma rom mene
Ngo mamite.
1.Ngat ma ogedo otel onyo kabedo ma lulim piny cito iye.
Pe culu mucoro pi rwom ma kimedo ikom kwed pi neno ni biacara meno tiyo, kit ma omyero onen kwede ki yub me gedo onyo cwalo/poko jami tic ma kiyubu gi ki itedero.
Pi kare ma kitye ka gedo/tyeko yubu kit kabedo meno.

Ngat matye ka yubu otel omyero otii ki ciling ma oloto romo dolla 8m. Kwed meno omyero obed pi yubu otel onyo kabedo pi lulim piny, onyo me kelo macin madongo  onyo jami mamite me konyo macin tic, ma nongo pe ginonge ilobo man. Otel onyo kabedo pa lulim piny man omyero obed ki ot butu matwero gwoko wele ma welgi kato  30. Ngat matye ki tam me yubu kabedo me kacoke matino wa ki madongo, ki kanyutu jami ma nongo wel me cako yub man kato dolla 1m.
1.    Jo mucone pi culu mucoro ma kingolo ikom rwom ma kimedo ikom gin acata.
Dano ducu ma gucone pi mucoro ikom rwom ma kimedo ikom gin acata (VAT) gi penyo pi cente ducu ma gutiyo kwede me culu mucoro meno.
Pi kare weng
Adwogi ma aa ki ibiacara maromo million 150m pi dwe 12 moo keken ityen me acel me cone pi VAT, kero me gwoko rekod tic ducu maber ki cato jami ma cik yee ni omyero kingol mucoro ikom gi.
CIK ME MUCORO MA KINGOLO PI TIC KI CITAM (STAMP DUTY ACT)
Tye pi anga
Kit yub ne
Pi kare ma rom mene
Yub me mucoro
1.   Ngat ma ogedo Otel onyo kabedo me gwoko lulim piny.
Pe culu mucoro I kom  citam pi cente pa wegi kampuni, cul mukene ma bino lacen, pango ngom, medo wel lim kampuni, kobo twero me ngom bot ngat mukene, miyo kony me timo kwed onyo goyo cal me gedo
Pi kare me kitye kagedo kit kabedo meno.
Omyero oket cente maromo dolla 8m I biacara meno. Otel onyo kabedo ma lulim piny bino iye omyero obed ki kero me gwoko wele makato 100.
2.   Yub me nyano lonyo I rwom ma lamal kit ma cik cimo kwede I nukta 60 A (iii), dul me aryo me cik ma kwako lok kom citam.
Mucoro pi citam pe kingolo.
Pi kare weng.

Lanya lonyo omyero obed ki: a.        Kero me olo twal tic ki pacen 50% me jami tic ma kiyubu/ki puru/ kinongo ki I kabedo ma en tye iye kace jami meno nonge. b.        Obed ki kero me tic ki pacen 50% me jami ma nonge ki lobo man, ki; c.        Obed ki kero me coyo lutic maromo 100 ki ikin anwyali me lobo man.
3. Penyo pi lim/cente den/adena.
Mucoro mo pe kingolo ikom mok/winye matye pi gwoko waraga me ngom onyo gin moo keken ma kijengo pi wel ma kideno ni.
Pi kare weng
Waraga me mok/winye matye pi gwoko waraga me ngom onyo gin moo keken ma kijengo pi wel ma kideno ni.
4. Penyo pi lim den
Mucoro mo pe kingolo ikom citam pi cente ma kigwoko onyo waraga me ot ma kijengo.
Pi kare weng

Waraga ma kijengo ki tyen lok me nongo lim den (mortgage) onyo me miyo ngec ikom cente onyo gedo ma ngat moni ogamo/onongo macalo adwogi me jeng meno me nongo lim adena ki bot ngat matye kamiyo lim den ma rom aroma ki wel ma kimito deno ne.
Kit jami moni
Yub matye pire.
a) Macin lalwok gaa/jami,  me lwoko bongi, cuka me apeta iwi kabuto, ki mukene.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
b). Jami/gaa me tedo ki me toko dek ma ginonge I jokon, tutwale ma ki tiyo kwedgi me tedo ki me toko dek me acama.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
c). Kuka me tedo, jami tedo, onyo kit gin mo keken makitiyo kwede me tedo.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
d). Macin buku yamo. Man obedo macin ma gwoko yamo bedo mangic onyo malyet, I ot, ganga ki kabedo mukene.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
e). Langol jami ma ticgi tye me ngolo cam keken macalo pala kwon, fok ki malaga ma kitiyo kwede me cam keken.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
f). TV, obedo macin ma gamo lok ki iyamo ki kelo I kompiuta ma nyute bot dano.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
g). Kapet, kapet obedo gin ma kitiyo kwede me umo dye ot kun iye opoke aryo, wiye mamalo ki tere ma cwiyo /mato pi.
•     Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
h). Jami ot Jami ot madongo macalo meja, kom, ma kitiyo kwede me yubu ot, opici, onyo kabedo mukene maber me kwo/ot bedo onyo ka tic.
•  Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
i). Bongo ki bongi me katen: cuka, ot pilo, ki bongo lawum wii kabuto. Katen :  obedo bongo ma kitweyo malo me umu wang ot onyo kanyuto cal, kun gibedo gin aryo kace ikumo ki wang ot.
•    Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.

j). Macin ma kitiyo kwede me rweyo kom dano I gym, man obedo kit macin moo keken makitiyo kwede icawa me rweyo lee, kun nongo medo tek pa tic kwede ceto malo onyo dwoko piny teke, onyo weko tic kwede bedo mit bot ngat matye katic kwede onyo adwogi me tic kwede pi kare ki kare.
•    Pe culu kit mucoro moo keken malube ki dul me abic (5) ite cik me tung kunyango me Africa (East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004.
2). Bongo lwok/latwo kom
•     Wel mucoro me kelo ne tye in pacen 0% me kaka 25% pi mwaka acel kace ngat matye ki lancic me timo biacara hotel aye owilo.
3). Macin latwo bongi
